title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array `nums`, find the contiguous, **non-empty** subarray with the largest sum and return that sum.
hints: Checking every subarray is O(n^2) even with prefix sums. Consider the best subarray ending at each index.
The best sum ending at i is either nums[i] alone, or nums[i] added to the best sum ending at i-1.
If the running sum becomes negative it only hurts any later subarray, so restart from the current element. Keep a global maximum.

solution.explanation: This is Kadane's algorithm. Keep the best sum of a subarray ending at the current element: either start fresh at this element or extend the previous run, so cur = max(x, cur + x). The answer is the maximum cur seen. Starting from the first element handles all-negative arrays correctly. One pass: O(n) time, O(1) space.
